records.deidentified_narrative: unit #1 was south bound, in a private parking lot. the driver made a left turn onto the driveway and was looking to her left attempting to pull into a vacant parking spot. unit #2 was walking from the business area across the driveway to her vehicle. unit #2 stated she thought unit #1 saw her and continued to cross the driveway, but unit #1 struck unit #2 in the left hip with the left front corner of the truck. the contact caused unit #2 to fall and unit #1 ran over her right foot with the front left tire of the truck. unit #2 said that when unit #1 heard her scream she immediately stopped the truck and got out to help her and call an ambulance. this parking lot is covered by security cameras and officer contacted stealth surveillance monitoring and requested the video during the time around this crash. after viewing the security video, officer was able to see unit #2 enter the driveway, walking north bound, before unit #1 made the left turn. unit #1 failed to yield the right of way to a pedestrian. no citation was issued because the crash occurred on private property.
